review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on, operationally focused role supporting SaaS services and infrastructure that must remain highly available and performant around the clock. Meet the Team You’ll join the Cloud Operations team – a hands-on engineering group responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of Sage’s production SaaS platforms across AWS and Azure. How Success Will Be Measured Reliability and availability of the cloud infrastructure and services you support, measured against SLAs Speed and quality of incident response and service restoration Measurable reduction in cloud waste and improvement in cost efficiency across your areas Quality and coverage of operational documentation, runbooks, and support procedures Contribution to automation initiatives that reduce manual operational overhead Positive collaboration with Engineering, Security, and Product stakeholders Qualifications 3+
